<TEI xmlns='http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0'><seg xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" type="excerpt" xml:id="ex040012026-09-0105-27-34" status="unreviewed"><rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:4243">'ban</rs> na de rung gi dkyil 'khor gyi steng
            du chu dang gsang du su du bung 'chags ste 'dzin par byed pa'i rung gis sus pas | zham
            bdag po yod pas | ma'am nus <lb edRef="inst:4749" n="152a7"/> dang 'du ba bzhin du | las kyi dbang gis phan
            tshun mi 'dra ba yino zhes ro || 
            
            de la <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:4261">'chims</rs> na de rnal 'byor spyod pas ltar na dkyil 'khor 3 rgya la nyi du 'dod pa yin te sa 'i dngos gzhi' de ltar bshad pa'o || chos mngon pa
            mdzod pa ltar <lb edRef="inst:4749" n="152a8"/> duM bu duM bur 'chags par 'dod pa yin no zhes <expan>zer ro</expan> ||</seg></TEI>
